filament_settings_id: zz Generic PLA Fast @BBL X2D 0.6 nozzle
name: zz Generic PLA Fast @BBL X2D 0.6 nozzle
description: Personal preset - the 'zz' prefix sorts it last in the preset lists. Generic PLA with flow pushed for a 0.6 mm hotend: volumetric speed 42 on every variant (Bambu ships 12 for Generic PLA) and 240 C for the flow headroom that needs. Layer cooling cut to 4 s / 40 mm/s. Step 2 after a clean 30 mm3/s test print. If walls come out thin or gaps appear between infill lines, drop the volumetric speed back toward 30-36 and lower the process speeds to match.
